method: Inner multi-ring ray polytope per signed actuator; continuous force ball enclosed by outer halfspace polytope; Cartesian product with torque box certified at every vertex.

cases.name: angulo_15
cases.lateral_lever_model: Hypothetical constant lever arms; real vane/duct free couples and centers of pressure are unknown.
cases.attitude_scope: Any attitude; force ball is a sufficient superset of gravity plus bounded acceleration
cases.coverage: Continuous force ball times torque box sufficient in declared ideal fixed-sign convex model; conservative capacity, not exact optimum.
